from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790687644/attempts/d21481a4026048e6979815abbac7f6cc/system/state/workspace/programs/task-ca3144ef.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    hsep = [r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    wsep = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    def spans(n, seps):
        bounds = [-1] + seps + [n]
        return [(bounds[i]+1, bounds[i+1]) for i in range(len(bounds)-1)]
    rs = spans(h,hsep); cs = spans(w,wsep)
    vals = Counter(v for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if r not in hsep and c not in wsep)
    bg = vals.most_common(1)[0][0]
    out=[]
    for r0,r1 in rs:
        line=[]
        for c0,c1 in cs:
            count=sum(grid[r][c] != bg for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1))
            line.append(1 if count >= 2 else 8)
        out.append(line)
    return out
'''
